notes: Part numbers are for the 19-suffix version, RG2PV40T6N19, in the October 2024 parts book; Bradford White's site lists the plain RG2PV40T6N as an archived model from before September 2021, and its parts were not checked. The gas valve shown is the natural gas one, and the LP valve number is in its spec.

gaps: The 19 suffix appears in the parts book and on Bradford White's current model list but is not explained; the spec sheets and the service manual write the model without it.
Blower rating: the service manual says 115 VAC, 60 Hz, 3.1 A, 3000 rpm; the spec sheets say 120 VAC for the power cord. The service manual's figures are used.
The 2016 sell sheet's footnote gives 120 VAC, 60 Hz, 3.1 A as the requirement for power venting without naming a part, so the blower rating comes from the service manual instead.
The parts book's page 9 lists a natural gas pilot assembly and burner assembly for this column; data/parts has no burner or pilot type, so they are not claimed.
Anode: the book lists magnesium, aluminium and A420 aluminium options; which one is fitted is not known.
The gas valve row gives both natural gas (415-48795-02) and LP (415-48796-02) numbers; both are in the spec.
method: Parts book #238-53865-00F, Power Vent Models (October 2024), copy on res.cloudinary (wholesale-plumbing): page 7 (RG2PV40T column, rendered and read), page 9 (burner and pilot rows, not claimed). Bradford White's own copy is the same revision.
Bradford White PV Series service manual #238-51540-00E (April 2019, docs.bradfordwhite.com), covers RG2PV40T*(N,X): page 6 specifications table (blower row, rendered and read).

Bradford White TTW power vent spec sheet 1261 (docs.bradfordwhite.com, footer 1261-0126): page 2, RG2PV40T6N row. The 2016 sell sheet PVNT-SS on cdn.bath1.com (Bradford White's own, (c) 2016) was read and agrees on capacity.
Bradford White For The Pro power vent page: lists RG2PV40T6N19 as current and RG2PV40T6N as archived (pre AquaVENT Max, before September 2021).
No retailer sites were used as sources for this record.

comps.spec: Blower motor, factory-installed; the service manual rates the blower 115 VAC, 60 Hz, 3.1 A, 3000 rpm
Flammable vapor sensor kit (2 pieces): Bradford White 415-45560-00
Gas valve, natural gas: Bradford White 415-48795-02 (LP gas valve 415-48796-02)
Hot water outlet anode rod; the book lists three options for this model: magnesium 415-55482-00, aluminium 415-55484-00 and A420 aluminium 415-55486-00 (may need cutting to length)
Tank rated 40 U.S. gal (33 imp. gal), with a DOE rated storage volume of 38 U.S. gal
